sentences.text: Sot Ardi është te gjyshja Drita.
sentences.english: Today Ardi is at grandmother Drita's.

sentences.text: Ai fle në dhomën e vogël.
sentences.english: He sleeps in the small room.

sentences.text: Në orën shtatë gjyshja e zgjon.
sentences.english: At seven o'clock grandmother wakes him.

sentences.text: — Mirëmëngjes, Ardi! Si je?
sentences.english: "Good morning, Ardi! How are you?"

sentences.text: — Jam mirë, gjyshe. Jam pak i lodhur.
sentences.english: "I am well, grandmother. I am a little tired."

sentences.text: Gjyshja përgatit bukë dhe çaj.
sentences.english: Grandmother prepares bread and tea.

sentences.text: Ardi ha bukë dhe pi qumësht.
sentences.english: Ardi eats bread and drinks milk.

sentences.text: Shkolla fillon në orën tetë.
sentences.english: School starts at eight o'clock.

sentences.text: Autobusi nuk është këtu.
sentences.english: The bus is not here.

sentences.text: Ardi është vonë!
sentences.english: Ardi is late!

sentences.text: Pas pesë minutash autobusi vjen.
sentences.english: After five minutes the bus comes.

sentences.text: Ardi shkon në shkollë.
sentences.english: Ardi goes to school.

sentences.text: Në mesditë Ardi vjen në shtëpi.
sentences.english: At midday Ardi comes home.

sentences.text: Gjyshja ka drekë: oriz dhe djathë.
sentences.english: Grandmother has lunch: rice and cheese.

sentences.text: Në mesditë ajo nuk është në treg.
sentences.english: At midday she is not at the market.

sentences.text: Në orën një ata hanë drekë bashkë.
sentences.english: At one o'clock they eat lunch together.

sentences.text: — Sot kam shkollë, gjyshe.
sentences.english: "Today I have school, grandmother."

sentences.text: — Çfarë mëson, Ardi?
sentences.english: "What do you learn, Ardi?"

sentences.text: — Mësoj shqip dhe lexoj një libër të madh.
sentences.english: "I learn Albanian and I read a big book."

sentences.text: Pasdite Ardi lexon një libër.
sentences.english: In the afternoon Ardi reads a book.

sentences.text: Gjyshja shkon në treg. Ardi shkon me të.
sentences.english: Grandmother goes to the market. Ardi goes with her.

sentences.text: Pasdite shumë njerëz blejnë bukë.
sentences.english: In the afternoon many people buy bread.

sentences.text: Gjyshja shet bukë. Ardi ka një çantë.
sentences.english: Grandmother sells bread. Ardi has a bag.

sentences.text: Një grua pyet: — Sa kushton buka?
sentences.english: A woman asks: "How much is the bread?"

sentences.text: Pas një minute gruaja ka bukë në çantë.
sentences.english: After a minute the woman has bread in her bag.

sentences.text: Pasdite ata shkojnë në shtëpi.
sentences.english: In the afternoon they go home.

sentences.text: Pas dhjetë minutash ata ulen në tavolinë.
sentences.english: After ten minutes they sit down at the table.

sentences.text: Në mesditë ata flasin shumë.
sentences.english: At midday they talk a lot.

sentences.text: Në mbrëmje ata janë në kuzhinë.
sentences.english: In the evening they are in the kitchen.

sentences.text: Mbi tavolinë ka një llambë.
sentences.english: On the table there is a lamp.

sentences.text: Ardi pyet: — Gjyshe, kur vjen ti te ne? Pse nuk vjen çdo javë?
sentences.english: Ardi asks: "Grandmother, when do you come to us? Why do you not come every week?"

sentences.text: Gjyshja thotë: — Duhet të punoj, Ardi.
sentences.english: Grandmother says: "I have to work, Ardi."

sentences.text: Mbrëmje, gjyshja i thotë Ardit një histori nga kisha.
sentences.english: In the evening grandmother tells Ardi a story from church.

sentences.text: — Ai vdiq për ne dhe u ringjall.
sentences.english: "He died for us and rose again."

sentences.text: Ardi dëgjon dhe buzëqesh.
sentences.english: Ardi listens and smiles.

sentences.text: Në mbrëmje Ardi fle.
sentences.english: In the evening Ardi sleeps.
